hooks.prompt:
Check the conversation: did Claude write or edit code files (via Edit or Write tools) in this session? If yes, check whether ALL of the following post-implementation steps were completed:

1. @server-reviewer and/or @frontend-reviewer (depending on what changed)
2. @verify <sub-task-id> (if working on a decentralization sub-task)
3. git commit
4. git push
5. Deploy to VPS (@deploy or manual SSH)

If code was written/edited but any of these steps were skipped, respond with:
"STOP: Post-implementation workflow incomplete. Still need: [list missing steps]. Run these before ending."

If no code was written, or all steps were completed, respond with nothing (empty).
